major_cooldowns.name: Frozen Orb
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Think about lining it up with a cleave window or an upcoming boss move before you press it, since it deals AoE damage for 15 seconds and tracking a moved target takes a few seconds to catch up.

major_cooldowns.name: Ray of Frost
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Save it for last in your priority list so it consumes as many Freezing stacks as possible before you channel it, then let the channel run its full 4 seconds.

rule.description: Frostbolt into Flurry, Frozen Orb, Ray of Frost
rule.action: Pre-cast Frostbolt, then open with Flurry, Frozen Orb, Ray of Frost, and Ice Lance in that order.

rule.description: Ice Lance on Fingers of Frost procs
rule.action: Cast Ice Lance as soon as Fingers of Frost procs so the Shatter bonus is not wasted.
Cast Flurry as soon as Brain Freeze procs to keep resetting its cooldown.

rule.description: Blizzard only with a full pack up
rule.action: Only weave Blizzard in once you are fighting 5 or more enemies; below that it loses to continuing to generate Splinters.
